clauses.title: Raw Material Classification
clauses.content: Pipes shall be manufactured from virgin polyethylene material of designation PE-63, PE-80, or PE-100 containing 2.0 to 2.5% carbon black.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Strength Test
clauses.content: Pipes must withstand internal hydrostatic pressure test at 80°C for 165 hours without failure or leakage.
